idea: Prompt-position jitter as an uncertainty proxy for SAM
problem: SAM gives no reliable confidence on ambiguous objects
hyp: Mask variance under small click perturbations predicts true error (IoU drop) better than SAM's IoU head
why: Cheap, model-agnostic uncertainty enables safe deployment
novel: Treats prompt space, not weight space, as the sampling axis
min_exp: Jitter clicks on 500 COCO+medical images; correlate variance with oracle IoU
risk: Variance may saturate on easy objects

idea: Does SAM's multimask output match human ambiguity distributions?
problem: Unknown whether SAM's 3 masks reflect real annotator disagreement
hyp: KL between SAM's mask set and multi-annotator mask distributions is lower than chance but fails on stuff-like classes
why: Validates SAM as an ambiguity model, not just a segmenter
novel: Quantitative alignment of model ambiguity with human ambiguity
min_exp: Compare on LIDC-IDRI multi-rater masks vs SAM multimask

idea: Calibration audit of SAM's IoU-prediction head on amorphous targets
problem: SAM's self-reported quality may be systematically wrong off-distribution
hyp: IoU head is overconfident on smoke/glass by >15 points but recalibratable with 100 labeled samples
why: Confidence gating decides automation vs human review
novel: Studies the predictor head itself, not masks
min_exp: Reliability diagrams on smoke/transparent/medical benchmarks
risk: Recalibration may not transfer across domains

idea: Measuring SAM's topology prior toward compact closed regions
problem: Unknown inductive bias against holes, thin parts, multi-component masks
hyp: SAM systematically fills holes and merges components; error scales with genus and component count
why: Explains failures on vessels, meshes, plumes
novel: Topology-controlled synthetic stimuli isolate the prior
min_exp: Synthetic shapes with varied genus; measure topology error vs pixel error

idea: Texture vs shape reliance in SAM via counterfactual stylization
problem: Unclear which cue SAM uses to delineate boundaries
hyp: Texture-swapped objects retain SAM boundaries; silhouette-only objects lose >20 boundary F1, showing texture dominance
why: Predicts failure domains (smoke, glass lack texture)
novel: Cue-conflict methodology applied to promptable segmentation
min_exp: Style-transfer cue-conflict set; measure boundary F1 per cue

idea: Aliasing from SAM's 1024 input grid on thin structures
problem: Thin vessels/wires may fall below effective sampling frequency
hyp: Recall on structures thinner than 3 native pixels drops predictably per a sampling-theory curve
why: Sets hard limits for medical thin-structure use
novel: Frames failures as signal-processing aliasing, not learning
min_exp: Synthetic lines of varying width/orientation; recall vs width plot
risk: Confound with training data scarcity of thin objects

idea: Frequency cutoff of SAM's mask decoder upsampling
problem: Decoder may low-pass filter boundaries regardless of encoder quality
hyp: Boundary spectra of SAM masks show a fixed cutoff absent in GT; sharper GT cannot be fit even when overfitting one image
why: Locates precision bottleneck architecturally
novel: Fourier analysis of mask decoders
min_exp: Fit single images; compare boundary curvature spectra
risk: Cutoff may vary with prompt type

idea: Image-border artifacts from positional encodings in SAM
problem: Objects touching image edges may be segmented worse
hyp: Boundary error rises within 32px of borders; padding/reflection tests isolate positional encoding as cause
why: Croppedscans and tiled inference hit borders constantly
novel: Systematic spatial-bias map of a promptable model
min_exp: Translate objects toward edges; plot error vs distance
risk: Effect may be small vs annotation noise

idea: Scaling law of interactive clicks to accuracy saturation
problem: No predictive theory of how many prompts fuzzy objects need
hyp: IoU vs click count follows a power law whose exponent is predictable from boundary fractal dimension
why: Enables annotation budgeting before labeling starts
novel: Connects object geometry to interaction cost quantitatively
min_exp: Simulated clicking on datasets with varied boundary complexity; fit exponents

idea: Error growth law of SAM2 mask propagation over time
problem: Unknown whether video tracking error grows linearly, exponentially, or plateaus
hyp: Error grows sub-linearly for rigid objects but super-linearly for deformable/amorphous ones, with a measurable phase transition
why: Determines re-prompting frequency for surveillance/surgery video
novel: Treats drift as a dynamical system with regimes
min_exp: Long videos, single initial prompt; fit error-vs-time curves per object class

idea: SAM2 under topology change: splitting and merging smoke plumes
problem: Memory attention assumes persistent object identity; plumes split/merge
hyp: SAM2 tracks the dominant component and silently drops split-off mass, losing >30% area within 20 frames of a split
why: Wildfire monitoring needs total plume coverage
novel: Topology-transition stress test for video memory models
min_exp: Synthetic+real splitting-smoke clips; measure retained mass post-split
risk: Hard to get GT for real smoke

idea: Which memory frames matter in SAM2's bank?
problem: Memory selection is heuristic (recency); informativeness unknown
hyp: Ablating memories shows a few high-motion or appearance-change frames carry most tracking accuracy; recency is suboptimal
why: Could shrink memory 4x for edge devices
novel: Shapley-style attribution over memory slots
min_exp: Leave-one-memory-out ablations on DAVIS/medical video

idea: Occlusion recovery limits of SAM2 memory
problem: Unknown max occlusion duration before identity loss
hyp: Recovery probability decays with occlusion length and background clutter following a measurable curve, independent of object size
why: Sets reliability envelopes for surgical tool tracking
novel: Psychophysics-style occlusion staircase for a video model
min_exp: Controlled occlusion insertions of varying duration; recovery rate curves

idea: Do SAM features linearly encode boundary sharpness?
problem: Unknown if fuzziness of an edge is represented or discarded
hyp: A linear probe on SAM embeddings predicts local edge gradient width with r>0.7, enabling fuzziness-aware downstream use
why: Soft-boundary information is key for smoke/tumor margins
novel: Probing for a continuous physical property, not classes
min_exp: Regress edge-profile width from patch embeddings on blurred edges
risk: Probe may exploit trivial intensity cues

idea: Layer-wise emergence of objectness in SAM's encoder
problem: Which depth first supports figure-ground separation is unknown
hyp: Object masks become linearly decodable at a consistent relative depth; ambiguous objects become decodable later or never
why: Guides efficient truncated encoders and explains ambiguity failures
novel: Depth-resolved objectness with ambiguity stratification
min_exp: Linear decoding of masks from each layer across object types

idea: Compositionality of SAM prompt embeddings
problem: Unknown if prompt space supports algebra (union, subtraction of regions)
hyp: Averaging embeddings of two clicks approximates their mask union above chance; subtraction approximates exclusion
why: Would enable programmatic mask composition without decoding twice
novel: Tests vector arithmetic in prompt space, unstudied
min_exp: Embedding arithmetic vs set-operation masks on 1k images

idea: What do negative clicks actually remove?
problem: Negative prompt semantics are undefined for ambiguous regions
hyp: Negative clicks remove whole visual parts (semantic units), not local pixels, causing over-deletion on gradient boundaries like smoke edges
why: Interactive refinement of fuzzy objects is currently unpredictable
novel: Characterizes deletion granularity as a measurable unit
min_exp: Place negatives at controlled distances from boundary; measure removed-region statistics

idea: Information content of prompt types in bits
problem: No principled comparison of box vs point vs mask prompts
hyp: Measured mutual information between prompt and output mask ranks prompts consistently, and predicts accuracy gains across datasets
why: Grounds prompt-choice guidelines in information theory
novel: Bits-per-prompt as a unifying currency
min_exp: Estimate MI via output entropy reduction per prompt type
risk: MI estimation noisy in high dimensions

idea: Disentangling epistemic vs aleatoric uncertainty via prompt vs weight ensembles
problem: Segmentation UQ conflates ambiguity sources
hyp: Prompt-ensemble variance tracks aleatoric (boundary fuzziness); checkpoint-ensemble variance tracks epistemic (domain shift); the two decorrelate on held-out shifts
why: Different sources demand different actions (more data vs defer)
novel: Uses SAM's promptability as a free aleatoric sampler
min_exp: Cross-correlate both variances under synthetic blur vs domain shift

idea: Conformal boundary bands for segmentation
problem: No distribution-free guarantees on where the true boundary lies
hyp: Morphological conformal calibration yields inner/outer bands containing the true boundary at nominal 90% coverage across shifts
why: Regulatory-grade guarantees for medical margins
novel: Conformalizes boundary location, not pixel labels
min_exp: Calibrate band radius on split data; test coverage under shift
risk: Bands may be uselessly wide on fuzzy objects

idea: Proper scoring rules for soft mask evaluation
problem: Thresholded IoU discards probability information and rewards overconfidence
hyp: Ranking models by Brier/log score on soft masks changes leaderboard order and better predicts downstream decision quality
why: Fuzzy-object benchmarks currently mismeasure progress
novel: Ports forecasting theory to mask evaluation with decision-linked validation
min_exp: Re-rank existing model zoo under proper scores; correlate with triage utility
risk: GT itself is binary in most sets

idea: A distributional metric for inherently ambiguous masks
problem: Single-GT metrics punish valid alternative segmentations
hyp: A Wasserstein-style distance between predicted and annotator mask distributions correlates with expert preference better than best-of-N IoU
why: Ambiguity-aware evaluation unlocks honest model comparison
novel: Optimal-transport geometry over mask sets
min_exp: Metric vs expert pairwise preferences on multi-rater data

idea: When do IoU and boundary F1 disagree, and which is right?
problem: Metric choice silently changes model rankings on fuzzy objects
hyp: Disagreement is predictable from object size and boundary fractal dimension; human judgment sides with boundary F1 below a size threshold
why: Gives principled per-object metric selection
novel: Meta-evaluation with geometry-conditioned analysis
min_exp: Rank correlation between metrics stratified by geometry; human study

idea: Defining smoke ground truth as density iso-contours
problem: Binary smoke masks are arbitrary; annotators pick different opacity cutoffs
hyp: Specifying GT as iso-contours of estimated transmittance reduces inter-annotator variance by half and improves cross-dataset transfer
why: Fixes the root cause of noisy smoke benchmarks
novel: Physically-grounded GT definition instead of better models
min_exp: Re-annotate 200 images at fixed opacity levels; measure variance

idea: Alpha-matte supervision vs binary masks for smoke
problem: Binary labels destroy the semi-transparent structure of plumes
hyp: Training on mattes then thresholding beats direct binary training on binary metrics too, because soft labels regularize boundaries
why: Better labels may beat better architectures
novel: Tests supervision format as the causal factor, matched capacity
min_exp: Same net, matte vs binary labels, evaluate both metric families

idea: Opacity regression as the primary smoke task
problem: Segmentation may be the wrong abstraction for gases
hyp: Per-pixel opacity regression yields better fire-alarm ROC than segmentation-then-threshold at equal supervision cost
why: Reframes an entire application pipeline
novel: Task reformulation, not module addition
min_exp: Compare alarm ROC of both pipelines on wildfire video
risk: Opacity GT approximated from smoke-composited synthetics

idea: Causal cue analysis for smoke recognition: motion vs texture vs color
problem: Unknown which cue detectors truly exploit, hurting transfer
hyp: Cue-ablated inputs (frozen frames, gray, texture-scrambled) show motion contributes most; models trained motion-free fail on fog negatives
why: Explains fog/cloud false alarms mechanistically
novel: Factorial cue-ablation design on video
min_exp: Ablate cues at test time on 3 smoke datasets; decompose accuracy

idea: Decomposing the synthetic-to-real gap for rendered smoke
problem: Simulated smoke training transfers poorly; the failing factor is unidentified
hyp: Gap is dominated by background composition realism, not smoke appearance; swapping only backgrounds recovers most transfer loss
why: Targets simulation effort where it matters
novel: Factor-wise gap attribution via controlled renders
min_exp: Render matrix varying smoke/background/lighting; train and test each

idea: Fire flicker spectra vs temporal sampling of video models
problem: Flame flicker (~10Hz) may alias at typical model frame rates
hyp: Detection accuracy dips when frame sampling aliases the dominant flicker band; matched sampling recovers it
why: A free accuracy gain via sampling choice
novel: Nyquist analysis of a detection task
min_exp: Vary temporal stride on fire video; accuracy vs stride vs flicker spectrum

idea: Trade-off law between minimum plume size and temporal integration
problem: Early fire detection lacks a size-latency operating theory
hyp: Detectable plume area shrinks as integration time grows following a square-root law until scene motion noise dominates
why: Quantifies achievable earliness for alarm systems
novel: Detection-theoretic (SNR accumulation) framing of early warning
min_exp: Sweep integration windows on early-smoke video; fit area-latency frontier

idea: A discriminative taxonomy of smoke look-alikes
problem: Fog, steam, clouds, dust cause most false alarms; their separating cues are uncataloged
hyp: A small set of measurable features (source attachment, buoyancy direction, spectral slope) separates smoke from each confuser above 90% each
why: False alarms, not misses, block deployment
novel: Confuser-centric science instead of smoke-centric
min_exp: Curate confuser set; test hand features and probes per pair

idea: Context dependence of glass segmentation via inpainting
problem: Unknown how much transparent-object masks rely on surrounding scene
hyp: Inpainting context outside the object drops glass IoU >25 points but barely affects opaque objects, quantifying context reliance
why: Predicts failures in novel scenes and guides data collection
novel: Causal context ablation with matched opaque controls
min_exp: Mask-context inpainting on GDD/Trans10K; IoU deltas

idea: Do models read refraction? Background-distortion probing
problem: Refractive distortion is a physical signature of transparency; usage unknown
hyp: Removing distortion (rendering flat glass) hurts models less than removing specular highlights, showing refraction is underused
why: Points to an untapped physical cue
novel: Physics-based cue knockout with controllable rendering
min_exp: Paired renders with/without refraction and highlights; per-cue accuracy

idea: Marginal value of polarization for transparent segmentation
problem: Polarization cameras exist but their benefit is unquantified per scene type
hyp: Polarization adds large gains only under diffuse lighting; under direct light RGB suffices, defining when the sensor pays off
why: Hardware decisions need condition-resolved evidence
novel: Condition-stratified sensor value analysis
min_exp: Collect paired RGB/polarization across lighting; gain per condition

idea: Rim-highlight dependence of glass boundary localization
problem: Boundaries may be inferred solely from thin specular rims
hyp: Suppressing rim highlights (cross-polarized capture or editing) collapses boundary F1 while region IoU survives, dissociating two mechanisms
why: Explains why matte glass and dim scenes fail
novel: Dissociates region vs boundary evidence channels
min_exp: Edit rims out; measure region vs boundary metrics separately

idea: Two-layer segmentation for see-through surfaces
problem: Pixels through glass belong to two objects; flat masks force a false choice
hyp: Annotating and predicting front-layer plus behind-layer masks improves grasp planning and matting over flat masks at equal label cost
why: Representation, not accuracy, is the bottleneck for robotics
novel: Questions the single-layer mask formalism itself
min_exp: Relabel small set two-layered; compare downstream grasp/matting proxy

idea: Mirror vs window: what cue decides?
problem: Reflection and transmission look alike; models confuse mirrors with openings
hyp: Models rely on framed-boundary priors, not optical consistency; violating frame priors flips predictions while violating geometry does not
why: Safety-critical for navigation robots
novel: Cue-conflict stimuli separating optics from context priors
min_exp: Composite frames/mirror content combinatorially; measure flips

idea: Predicting the inter-observer variance map from a single image
problem: Where experts will disagree is unknown before collecting many raters
hyp: A model trained on multi-rater medical data predicts per-pixel rater variance on unseen anatomy with r>0.6, transferring across organs
why: Targets multi-rater budget where disagreement lives
novel: Variance itself as the prediction target, cross-organ
min_exp: Train on LIDC variance maps; test on different organ multi-rater set

idea: Audit of systematic over- vs under-segmentation in public medical GT
problem: Label bias direction is unmeasured; models inherit it silently
hyp: Public datasets show consistent organ-specific bias (e.g., tumors over-included) detectable via boundary-gradient statistics without re-annotation
why: Bias-corrected training could beat bigger models
novel: Dataset forensics from image-mask consistency alone
min_exp: Compare mask edges to intensity gradients across 10 datasets
risk: Gradient prior wrong for some tissues

idea: Annotation drift within long-running datasets
problem: Labeling conventions shift over collection years, contaminating benchmarks
hyp: Ordering samples by acquisition date reveals monotonic label-style drift; date-stratified evaluation changes model rankings
why: Temporal leakage silently inflates reported progress
novel: Treats dataset creation as a longitudinal process
min_exp: Regress label statistics on acquisition date in dated datasets

idea: Sub-pixel boundary estimation under partial volume effect
problem: CT/MR boundaries live between voxels; hard labels quantize them
hyp: Modeling boundaries as sub-voxel level sets fit to intensity mixtures reduces volumetric bias in small lesions by >10%
why: Small-lesion volumetry drives treatment decisions
novel: Physics of image formation as the label model
min_exp: Phantom scans with known geometry; volume error vs voxel labels
risk: Mixture model wrong for complex tissue

idea: Optimal slice selection theory for 3D annotation
problem: Which slices to annotate in a volume is chosen ad hoc
hyp: Slice informativeness follows a curvature-driven law: annotating slices at shape inflection points beats equal spacing by >15% at equal budget
why: Direct multiplier on 3D labeling budgets
novel: Geometry-derived, model-free selection rule
min_exp: Simulate budgets on fully-labeled volumes; reconstruction error per policy

idea: Is SAM2 slice-propagation a valid 3D segmenter?
problem: Treating volumes as videos ignores anisotropy and lacks 3D consistency guarantees
hyp: SAM2 propagation error correlates with slice spacing and through-plane curvature, and violates 3D smoothness measurably vs native 3D methods
why: Many groups adopt this shortcut without characterization
novel: Systematic validity study, not a method paper
min_exp: Propagate across anisotropies; measure 3D consistency metrics

idea: Radiologist gaze as free segmentation prompts
problem: Prompting requires deliberate clicks; gaze is collected passively
hyp: Fixation clusters converted to point prompts reach within 5 IoU of manual clicks for organ segmentation, at zero added interaction cost
why: Could make every reading session produce labels
novel: Passive physiological signal as prompt source
min_exp: Replay public eye-tracking radiology data into SAM; compare to clicks
risk: Gaze lands on diagnostic, not boundary, regions

idea: Does boundary uncertainty carry prognostic signal?
problem: Tumor margin fuzziness may reflect infiltration, but is discarded by binary masks
hyp: Model-estimated boundary uncertainty adds independent predictive value for invasion/grade beyond size and radiomics
why: Turns a nuisance (ambiguity) into a biomarker
novel: Uncertainty as clinical feature, not error bar
min_exp: Cox/logistic models with and without uncertainty features on outcome-linked data

idea: Uncertainty maps as predictors of human correction time
problem: UQ is evaluated against GT, not against the effort it should allocate
hyp: Pixel uncertainty predicts annotator correction seconds better than error maps do, because effort depends on ambiguity not mistake size
why: Reframes UQ evaluation around its actual use
novel: Human-time as the UQ validation target

idea: Benchmark contamination from SAM-assisted annotation
problem: New datasets labeled with SAM assistance may bias evaluation toward SAM-like errors

why: The field may be grading itself with its own pen
novel: Circularity audit of the annotation ecosystem

idea: A measured cost model for interactive prompt policies
problem: Prompt strategies are optimized for accuracy per click, but clicks cost unequal human time

why: Aligns interactive segmentation research with real budgets
novel: Empirical human time constants replace click counting
min_exp: User study timing prompt types; re-solve policy under seconds

idea: Information rate of scribbles vs clicks
problem: Scribble supervision is assumed richer but never quantified per unit effort

why: Per-object prompt routing saves budget
novel: Bits-per-second framing with geometric crossover law
min_exp: Measure model gain per timed interaction across shape families

idea: Active learning validity under boundary label noise
problem: Uncertainty sampling may preferentially query pixels where GT itself is unreliable

why: Explains reported AL failures in medical imaging
novel: Interaction between AL and label noise, usually studied separately

idea: Beyond majority vote: distribution-preserving mask aggregation
problem: Averaging raters erases legitimate multimodality (e.g., include-edema vs exclude)

novel: Treats rater disagreement as modes, not noise

idea: A measurable taxonomy of segmentation ambiguity sources
problem: Blur, occlusion, semantic vagueness, and transparency are lumped as 'hard'

novel: Operationalizes ambiguity types with detectors
min_exp: Label ambiguity sources on 1k hard cases; train signature classifier

idea: Does calibration transfer across imaging domains?
problem: Models calibrated on one scanner/site may be miscalibrated elsewhere in unknown ways
hyp: Calibration error under shift is predictable from feature-space distance, allowing calibration-transfer without target labels
why: Recalibration data is often unavailable at deployment
novel: Predictive theory of calibration drift, not post-hoc fixes
min_exp: Multi-site medical data; regress ECE change on domain distance

idea: Why open-vocabulary detectors fail on stuff-like classes
problem: Smoke, water, and dust are queryable by text but detected poorly; the failure mode is uncharacterized
hyp: Failures stem from box-centric training priors, not text embedding quality; region-text alignment scores remain high while localization collapses
why: Separates representation failure from head failure
novel: Diagnostic decomposition of open-vocab pipelines on stuff
min_exp: Probe alignment vs localization separately for stuff queries

idea: Does segmentation pretraining transfer to tiny-object detection?
problem: Whether dense mask pretraining helps sub-20px detection is untested
hyp: SAM-style pretraining improves tiny-object recall only when finetuning preserves stride-4 features; gains vanish at coarser strides, isolating the mechanism
why: Guides pretraining choice for aerial fire and lesion detection
novel: Mechanism-controlled transfer study
min_exp: Finetune with controlled feature strides on tiny-object benchmarks

idea: Counting overlapping translucent instances
problem: Instance segmentation assumes visible separations; overlapping translucent objects (cells, bubbles, glassware) violate this
hyp: Density-integral counting beats instance mask counting once pairwise overlap exceeds a measurable threshold
why: Defines when to abandon instance masks for counting tasks
novel: Phase-diagram of task formulations vs overlap regime
min_exp: Synthetic overlap sweeps plus cell data; count error per method

idea: Predicting SAM failure from image statistics alone
problem: Users cannot tell in advance whether SAM will work on their domain
hyp: A lightweight regressor on image statistics (edge density, texture entropy, contrast) predicts per-image SAM IoU with r>0.65 without running SAM
why: Zero-cost triage for annotation pipelines
novel: Pre-hoc, model-free failure forecasting
min_exp: Fit regressor across 15 datasets; test on held-out domains

idea: Order effects in interactive prompt sequences
problem: Whether click ordering matters (same set, different sequence) is unknown
hyp: SAM-style models show significant order sensitivity on ambiguous objects, revealing hidden state; order-invariance correlates with robustness
why: Order sensitivity breaks reproducibility of interactive protocols
novel: Permutation testing of interaction sequences
min_exp: Permute click orders on fixed sets; variance of final masks

idea: Motion-coherence prior of SAM2 vs incoherent objects
problem: Smoke and fire move incoherently; video models may assume rigid-ish flow

why: Identifies the governing variable of video failure on fluids
novel: Flow-statistics as the explanatory axis

idea: Boundary stability of SAM under nuisance transforms
problem: How much boundaries move under illumination, blur, JPEG is unquantified

idea: Fractal dimension of object boundaries as a difficulty law
problem: No quantitative predictor of segmentation difficulty from shape alone
hyp: Across datasets and models, boundary error scales with boundary fractal dimension by a common exponent, forming a universal difficulty law
why: Enables dataset difficulty certification before training
novel: Universal scaling claim testable across domains
min_exp: Compute fractal dimension vs error across 20 datasets and 5 models

idea: Psychophysics of human boundary tracing precision
problem: The human precision floor for tracing fuzzy edges is unknown, so 'annotation noise' is unmodeled
hyp: Human tracing error follows a lawful function of edge gradient width and zoom, giving a per-pixel noise model usable as a label prior
why: Separates model error from irreducible label error
novel: Measures the annotator as an instrument

idea: Does annotation zoom level set a benchmark ceiling?
problem: GT precision depends on the zoom annotators used; benchmarks may saturate at that ceiling

why: Progress may be measurable only with sharper rulers
novel: Ruler-precision audit of benchmarks
min_exp: Re-annotate 200 images at high zoom; re-evaluate leaderboard models

idea: Connectivity-aware metrics vs clinical utility for tubular structures
problem: Pixel metrics ignore breaks in vessels/airways that destroy downstream use
hyp: A centerline-connectivity metric predicts surgical-planning usability ratings far better than Dice, with rank correlation gap >0.3
why: Aligns evaluation with what clinicians need
novel: Utility-anchored metric validation, not another metric proposal
min_exp: Clinician usability ratings vs metric ranks on vessel segmentations

idea: Topological error profiling with persistent homology
problem: Which topological mistakes (breaks, false loops) models make, and when, is uncharted
hyp: Persistence diagrams of prediction-GT differences cluster into few recurring failure motifs stable across architectures
why: Motif-level understanding guides targeted fixes
novel: TDA as a failure-taxonomy instrument, not a loss
min_exp: Compute persistence-based error signatures across models on curvilinear data

idea: Mining spatial extent supervision from radiology reports
problem: Reports contain size/location phrases that are discarded for segmentation
hyp: Parsing measurements and laterality from reports gives weak constraints that recover >70% of full-mask training value for lesion segmentation
why: Millions of reports already exist; masks do not
novel: Text-derived geometric constraints, not text embeddings
min_exp: Extract constraints from MIMIC-CXR reports; constrained training vs baselines

idea: Test-time prompt augmentation as Monte Carlo inference
problem: Single-prompt SAM output is a point estimate with unknown variance
hyp: Averaging masks over sampled equivalent prompts approximates the posterior mean and improves both accuracy and calibration, with diminishing returns after ~8 samples
why: Free ensemble without retraining
novel: Formalizes prompt augmentation as posterior sampling with convergence analysis
min_exp: Sweep sample counts; accuracy and ECE vs samples

idea: Memorization audit: does SAM know benchmark images?
problem: SA-1B overlap with evaluation sets may inflate reported zero-shot numbers

why: Zero-shot claims underpin the field's narrative
novel: Contamination forensics for segmentation foundations
min_exp: Perceptual-hash matching SA-1B vs benchmarks; stratified evaluation

idea: Boundary style transfer between annotation conventions
problem: Datasets disagree systematically (tight vs loose boundaries), blocking pooled training
hyp: A learned per-dataset boundary offset field harmonizes conventions, and pooled training after harmonization beats naive pooling by >3 Dice
why: Unlocks combining scarce medical datasets
novel: Models inter-dataset bias as a learnable geometric transform
min_exp: Learn offsets between overlapping-anatomy datasets; pooled-training comparison

idea: Optical-flow divergence as free smoke pseudo-labels
problem: Smoke video labels are scarce; expanding gases have a physical flow signature
hyp: Regions of positive flow divergence with upward drift yield pseudo-labels that train a segmenter to within 10 IoU of fully supervised
why: Physics substitutes for annotation at scale
novel: Uses fluid kinematics, not appearance, as the label source

idea: Decoupling smoke source localization from plume extent
problem: Alarm systems need the source point; segmentation optimizes plume area instead

why: Optimizing the actual decision variable improves response time
novel: Task decomposition questioning segmentation's role

idea: Cue inventory for infrared and night-time smoke
problem: Night smoke detection relies on unknown cues; RGB findings may not apply

idea: Layered vs flat mask representations for semi-transparent overlap
problem: Overlapping translucent regions (smoke over smoke, glass stacks) cannot be expressed by one-hot masks

why: Representation limits both labels and models
novel: Extends the mask formalism itself with measured costs
min_exp: Annotate overlap subset both ways; measure downstream compositing error

idea: Optimal prompt timing in video: when to click
problem: SAM2 users prompt the first frame by convention; the best frame is unknown
hyp: Prompting at frames of maximal object-background contrast and minimal motion beats first-frame prompting by >5 J&F on average
why: Costless accuracy gain for video annotation
novel: Frame-selection as a formal decision problem
min_exp: Oracle sweep over prompt frames; learn a frame-quality predictor

idea: When is instance count ill-defined? Cell clump case study
problem: For merging cells or dividing nuclei, even experts disagree on object count
hyp: Expert count disagreement is predictable from morphology (neck width ratio), defining a measurable ill-posedness boundary for instance tasks
why: Benchmarks should not grade the ungradable
novel: Formalizes count ill-posedness with a measurable criterion
min_exp: Multi-expert counting on clumps; regress disagreement on morphology
risk: Criterion may not generalize past cells

idea: Cross-modality ground truth bias: CT vs MR of the same anatomy
problem: The same organ gets systematically different GT boundaries per modality; the bias size is unknown
hyp: Registered same-patient CT/MR annotations differ systematically (not randomly) by tissue type, and models inherit the acquisition-specific bias
why: Multi-modal training and evaluation assume label consistency
novel: Quantifies GT as modality-dependent, not absolute
min_exp: Register paired scans; measure signed boundary offsets by tissue

idea: Do learned quality metrics match humans on fuzzy boundaries?
problem: Learned mask-quality estimators are validated on crisp objects only
hyp: On fuzzy objects, learned metrics' agreement with expert preference drops below simple boundary metrics, exposing training-distribution bias
why: Auto-evaluation increasingly gates model selection
novel: Meta-evaluation targeting the fuzzy regime specifically
min_exp: Expert pairwise preferences on fuzzy cases vs metric scores

idea: Uncertainty-aware suppression for overlapping ambiguous detections
problem: NMS assumes one true box; ambiguous objects (plumes, reflections) legitimately overlap
hyp: Replacing hard suppression with disagreement-preserving output sets improves downstream alarm precision-recall on ambiguous classes without hurting crisp classes
why: Post-processing, not the detector, discards valid hypotheses
novel: Questions NMS's uniqueness assumption with class-conditional evidence
min_exp: Compare suppression schemes on smoke/reflection detection benchmarks

idea: Limits of recursive zoom-and-refine prompting
problem: Self-refinement by cropping and re-prompting SAM is popular but its convergence is uncharacterized
hyp: Iterated zoom refinement converges for high-contrast boundaries but oscillates or diverges on fuzzy ones, with a predictable stability criterion
why: Practitioners need to know when iteration helps or harms
novel: Fixed-point analysis of an inference-time procedure
min_exp: Iterate refinement to convergence across boundary types; map stability regions

idea: Budget allocation: more images vs more raters per image
problem: Fixed annotation budgets are split by convention, not evidence, for ambiguous domains
hyp: For fuzzy-boundary tasks, past a threshold ambiguity level, adding raters per image improves trained-model calibration more than adding images, with a measurable crossover
why: Every ambiguous-domain dataset faces this decision
novel: Empirical crossover law for a universal design choice
min_exp: Subsample multi-rater datasets under fixed budgets; train and compare
